cases.name: Jennifer Michelle Sines
cases.about: Her sister wrote on Go Fund Me: Jennifer lived in Covington Washington, where she was close to her immediate family and most importantly, our Mother. The home consisted of multiple rooms that were rented to herself and several others. Within that home, a man who had individual conflict with Jennifer and other residence was, waking up from his last night as a tenant. The man was loading his truck to depart from the home when he let Jennifer’s overly loved kitten, Elsa out the door. With a physical nudge and spiteful words to accompany his hostile exit out the door. It wasn’t until Jennifer walked into her room, that she realized Elsa had been let out, again. She headed to the front door in an attempt to find her kitten but was confronted by the man reentering the home with a shotgun. Jennifer was shot twice and was quickly claimed, as God’s newest Angel. The man continued his way up the stairs & back into his room where he took his own life."

cases.name: Thuyền Thị Hoàng
cases.about: Her obituary said she was born and raised in Vietnam. Using Google Translate to translate from Vietnamese to English, it read: "Mother is the eldest child in a family of 4 siblings. Mother Boat is a filial daughter and a mother who loves her children dearly. Mom often calls her parents in Vietnam to talk and check on their health. Mom loves to cook delicious dishes for her family members and especially her children, because that's how she shows her love. Mother often cooks bun bo Hue, vermicelli vermicelli, filter cake, chicken rice, fried chicken wings with fish sauce on weekends and calls her children to eat rice. Mom wakes up early every morning to prepare rice and water for her daughter Cam to go to work. Mom loves taking her youngest daughter shopping and taking pictures for her, and she always says "I love you". Mother is not only a filial son, a gentle mother, she is also a sister who takes care of her younger brothers and is an aunt that any grandchild loves very much. Mom always takes care of her grandchildren's education in Vietnam. Every year on the occasion of the first day of school, my mother always sends me an admission gift with words of encouragement to the children to study hard to have a bright future in the future. In addition, she also likes to plant trees, take care of the garden, go to the park, go somewhere sightseeing with her family and sing Karaoke. In her life, her mother has always worked hard and worked hard from the time she was in Vietnam until she left her homeland to come to the United States to settle down. Mom has worked through many different jobs from farming, trading, doing vegetables at the market, cooking at restaurants, to doing nails. No matter where she is or how she works, she always saves money to take care of her family and never complains a word. She is loved by all family members, friends, colleagues, and neighbors because of her hard work and warm heart."
